name: Earthy Cummy
source:
You have been asked by Cummy Industries to help test their latest virtual simulation technology and interact with their latest creation, Earthy! It’s up to you to decide how to talk to and treat Earthy, and the simulation will be constantly reacting to your choices!

[From Itch.io]
translation:
Cummy Industries邀请你帮助测试他们最新的虚拟模拟技术，并与他们的最新作品Earthy进行互动！由你决定如何与Earthy交谈和治疗，并且模拟将不断对你的选择做出反应！

[来自Itch.io]
